coordinate_system: atlas pixels and corresponding model XY; not metres or game-engine coordinates
scope: One supplied gameplay clip. Sampled frames do not establish continuous tracking or whole-map localization accuracy.

validation_protocol.query_partition: Spatially deduplicated query features are partitioned before atlas matching.
validation_protocol.candidate_selection: Only fit features choose automatic search region; manual ROI is a separate condition.
validation_protocol.fit_holdout_independent: Heldout features do not fit the transform or displace fit targets; index disjointness checked on export.
validation_protocol.acceptance: At least 8 fit inliers, fit support >=65%, at least 4 heldout points, heldout bbox >=15% of query, >=80% heldout within 2.5 query px, heldout median <=1.5 query px.
validation_protocol.outlier_reporting: p95 uses all heldout correspondences, including outliers. Accepted samples with outliers remain explicitly separate.
validation_protocol.accuracy_limit: No ground-truth world positions are available. Correspondence residuals are not demonstrated 3D accuracy.
validation_protocol.material_policy: No raw atlas images, third-party videos, local filesystem paths, or arbitrary source metadata included.

conditions.timestamp_origin: seconds from start of supplied clip, not original full-match clock
conditions.timing_scope: matching only; excludes video decoding, atlas initialization, and model generation
